definitions.text_mt: Xi ħadd ieħor minbarra dak imsemmi

usage_examples.mt: Ma rajt lil ħaddieħor għajr lilu.
usage_examples.en: I saw no one else other than him.

usage_examples.mt: Għajr dan, kollox hu sew.
usage_examples.en: Other than this, everything is fine.

definitions.text_mt: Għajat qawwi u f'daqqa minn persuna
Tbikbija jew twerżiqa
Fehma kollettiva maħsuba mill-maġġoranza
Sejħa jew ħeġġa biex wieħed isegwi karriera partikolari

usage_examples.mt: Smajt għajta qawwija mill-bogħod.
usage_examples.en: I heard a loud cry from afar.

usage_examples.mt: Missieri tawni għajta għax kont tard.
usage_examples.en: My father gave me a reprimand because I was late.

usage_examples.mt: L-għajta tal-poplu kienet kontra l-gwerra.
usage_examples.en: Public opinion was against the war.

definitions.text_mt: Mezzi ta' sussistenza biex wieħed jgħix
Medda ta' żmien li persuna tibqa' ħajja
Mara impjegata biex tieħu ħsieb it-tfal u d-dar ta' ħaddieħor

usage_examples.mt: Jaħdem ħafna għall-għajxa ta' familthu.
usage_examples.en: He works hard for his family's livelihood.

usage_examples.mt: Għexet għajxa twila u mimlija ferħ.
usage_examples.en: She lived a long and joyful life.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet tgħix bħala għajxa fid-dar ta' sinjur.
usage_examples.en: She lived as a governess in a rich man's house.

definitions.text_mt: Mezzi finanzjarji jew materjali għas-sussistenza ta' persuna
Dak li jaqla' wieħed biex jgħix
Baqa' ħaj minkejja periklu jew diffikultà
Stil ta' ħajja jew mod kif wieħed igħix

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi jiddependi fuq l-art għall-għajxien tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: The farmer depends on the land for his livelihood.

usage_examples.mt: L-għajxien f'dal-pajjiż sar diffiċli.
usage_examples.en: Making a living in this country has become difficult.

usage_examples.mt: L-għajxien tiegħu wara l-inċident kien miraklu.
usage_examples.en: His survival after the accident was a miracle.

definitions.text_mt: Sustanza ħoxna, niedja u li twaħħal
Qsusija estrema fix-xiri jew fl-infiq

usage_examples.mt: L-għakar kien mifrux mal-art kollha tal-kantina.
usage_examples.en: The slime was spread all over the cellar floor.

usage_examples.mt: L-għakar tiegħu ma jħallihx jonfoq flusu.
usage_examples.en: His miserliness does not let him spend his money.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu konsistenza ħoxna u jwaħħal
Li għandu wiċċ niedi u twaħħal mal-mess

usage_examples.mt: Din is-sustanza hija għakkra ħafna.
usage_examples.en: This substance is very viscous.

usage_examples.mt: Idejh kienu għakkarin bl-għaraq.
usage_examples.en: His hands were clammy with sweat.

definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel xi ħaġa twaħħal jew takkwista konsistenza ħoxna
Iqatta' l-ħin għalxejn mingħajr ma jagħmel xogħol utli

usage_examples.mt: Is-sħana għakkret iż-żejt fit-taġen.
usage_examples.en: The heat made the oil in the pan viscous.

usage_examples.mt: Qagħad jgħakkar il-ħajjat mingħajr ma għamel xejn.
usage_examples.en: He sat around killing time without doing anything.

definitions.text_mt: Iżomm lin-nies taħt kontroll qawwi u inġust
Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jissottometti għar-rieda tiegħu
Iżomm milli jagħmel xi ħaġa billi juża l-forza jew l-awtorità
Ineħħi minn xi ħadd id-dritt jew il-possibbiltà li jgawdi xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Id-dittatur għakkes lill-poplu għal ħafna snin.
usage_examples.en: The dictator oppressed the people for many years.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rebħa għakkiset lill-ghadu.
usage_examples.en: The victory subdued the enemy.

usage_examples.mt: Ġiegħlu jgħakkes ir-rabja tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: They made him restrain his anger.

definitions.text_mt: Tbajja' jew ħxuna fil-ġilda fuq l-ispalla kkawżata minn attrizzjoni

usage_examples.mt: L-għakra fuq spalltu kienet kbira u iebsa.
usage_examples.en: The callus on his shoulder was large and hard.

definitions.text_mt: Kostellazzjoni fiż-żodijaku li tixbah l-iskorpjun
Is-sinjal taż-żodijaku msejjaħ Skorpjun

usage_examples.mt: Il-kostellazzjoni ta' l-Għakreb tidher fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: The constellation of Scorpius appears in summer.

usage_examples.mt: Jien imwieled taħt is-sinjal ta' l-Għakreb.
usage_examples.en: I was born under the sign of Scorpio.

definitions.text_mt: Bebbuxa ta' l-art bil-qoxra

usage_examples.mt: Sibt għakrux ġewwa l-ġnien wara x-xita.
usage_examples.en: I found a land snail in the garden after the rain.

usage_examples.mt: L-għakrux kien moħbi taħt il-ġebla.
usage_examples.en: The snail was hidden under the stone.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ġog bejn l-għadam tar-riġel u dak tas-sieq

usage_examples.mt: Tweġġgħet l-għaksa waqt li kienet tiġri.
usage_examples.en: She sprained her ankle while running.

usage_examples.mt: L-għaksa torbot is-sieq mar-riġel.
usage_examples.en: The ankle connects the foot to the leg.

definitions.text_en: to express indifference or unconcern: indifferently
definitions.text_mt: B'mod indifferenti jew mingħajr interess

usage_examples.mt: Wieġeb għala bieb mingħajr ma ħaseb.
usage_examples.en: He answered indifferently without thinking.

definitions.text_en: diminutive of għalqa: a small field
definitions.text_mt: Għalqa żgħira, ġeneralment għall-użu agrikolu

usage_examples.mt: Ixtara għalajqa żgħira barra r-raħal.
usage_examples.en: He bought a small field outside the village.

usage_examples.mt: L-għalajqa tagħna fiha l-ħaxix kollu.
usage_examples.en: Our small field has all the vegetables.

definitions.text_mt: Dudu tal-ilma li jerdgħu d-demm minn annimali jew bnedmin

usage_examples.mt: L-għalaq kien imwaħħal ma' riġlu wara li mar jgħum.
usage_examples.en: The leech was attached to his leg after he went swimming.

usage_examples.mt: L-għalaq jgħix fl-ilma wieqaf.
usage_examples.en: The leech lives in stagnant water.

definitions.text_en: to close, to shut a book, fan, or anything foldable a door, window, or anything with a latch or lid
definitions.text_mt: Ixgħel xi ħaġa miftuħa bħal bieba, tieqa, ktieb jew għatu
Iġib xi ħaġa fit-tmiem jew jikkonkludiha

usage_examples.mt: L-għalliem għalaq il-ktieb u ħareġ mill-klassi.
usage_examples.en: The teacher closed the book and left the classroom.

usage_examples.mt: Għalaq il-bieb warajh bil-mod.
usage_examples.en: He closed the door quietly behind him.

usage_examples.mt: Il-laqgħa ngħalqet wara sagħtejn.
usage_examples.en: The meeting concluded after two hours.

definitions.text_en: to make a mistake, to err
definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel żball jew jidħol f'għelt

usage_examples.mt: Għalat meta qal li kien fi Franza.
usage_examples.en: He made a mistake when he said he was in France.

usage_examples.mt: Min jgħalat irid jitgħallem mill-iżbalji tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He who errs must learn from his mistakes.

definitions.text_mt: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed jegħleb jew jirbaħ

usage_examples.mt: L-għalb tal-għadu kien diffiċli imma possibbli.
usage_examples.en: The overcoming of the enemy was difficult but possible.

definitions.text_mt: Bl-iskop jew bil-għan li

usage_examples.mt: Studja ħafna għalbiex jgħaddi l-eżami.
usage_examples.en: He studied hard so that he would pass the exam.

usage_examples.mt: Ġejt hawn għalbiex nitkellem miegħek.
usage_examples.en: I came here so that I could talk to you.

definitions.text_mt: Bħala riżultat dirett ta' dan

usage_examples.mt: Kien tard, u għaldaqshekk telaq mingħajr ma kiel.
usage_examples.en: He was late, and consequently he left without eating.

usage_examples.mt: Għaldaqshekk, il-proġett ġie ikkanċellat.
usage_examples.en: Therefore, the project was cancelled.
